$comment: GOLDEN DRAW LOG for the first screen's spend shape (#1512). This harness cannot rasterise, so this is the deterministic stand-in for a golden pixel comparison: the ordered sequence of primitive calls the chart makes, with every rectangle and every label in DEVICE pixels. It is the bundled example dataset, laid out at a 520 css-px measured width and a device-pixel ratio of 2 — a retina layout, because that is the one a css-pixel bug hides in. Regenerate it only when the drawing genuinely changes, and say in the pull request what moved and why.
